content: Google Gemini AI SDK: The current SDK is @google/genai (v2.10.0), NOT the older @google/generative-ai (v0.24.1). The older SDK no longer receives Gemini 2.0+ features. Install: npm install @google/genai. Usage: import { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai'; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY}); const response = await ai.models.generateContent({ model: 'gemini-2.5-flash', contents: 'prompt' }); console.log(response.text). Model gemini-2.5-flash is the stable recommended model for text generation. gemini-2.0-flash is marked as shutdown. Free tier is available via Google AI Studio key. GEMINI_API_KEY env var is automatically picked up when client is initialized without args.
